cases.prompt: Add three fixed alternate greetings with different starting state to this MVU card.

cases.prompt: Assemble the maintained sources, validate them, and produce versioned JSON and PNG release artifacts.

cases.expectedBehavior: Compare counts by stable rule ID, report positive deltas as regressions, and avoid treating a baseline as a suppression list.

cases.expectedBehavior: Validate stable binding IDs, table and field references, access owner and refresh events, keep UI implementation separate, and retain real multi-floor lifecycle acceptance.

cases.expectedBehavior: Verify local containment, bytes and hashes, leave remote sources uncontacted, require an explicit Live2D provider and fallback, and pair load/play actions with teardown.

cases.expectedBehavior: Produce a non-network preload plan, enforce declared byte and count limits, use only BGM or ambient audio contracts, preserve existing settings, and validate deterministic cleanup.
